section: Transport in India - roads (NH network, Bharatmala), railways (zones), pipelines
subsections: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI

accepted.s: The Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) was established in which year, and where is its headquarters located?
accepted.x: IWAI was established in 1986 and its headquarters is located at Noida.
accepted.tq: Use the institution–year–headquarters combination to distinguish IWAI from the National Waterways Act.
accepted.sec: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Waterways Act, 2016:
1. It declared 111 National Waterways.
2. The waterways so declared have an approximate total length of 20,187 km.
3. The Act was enacted in 1986.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false: the National Waterways Act was enacted in 2016, whereas IWAI was established in 1986.
accepted.tq: Separate the year of the Act from the year of establishment of IWAI.
accepted.sec: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: As of November 2025, how many National Waterways were operational over approximately what length?
accepted.x: As of November 2025, 32 National Waterways were operational over approximately 5,155 km.
accepted.tq: Match the operational count with the operational length rather than the total declared network.
accepted.sec: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: National Waterway-1 extends between which of the following places?
accepted.x: National Waterway-1 extends from Haldia to Prayagraj over the Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly system.
accepted.tq: Test the endpoint pair of the waterway instead of its river name.
accepted.sec: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes National Waterway-1?
o: It is 1,620 km long and lies on the Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly system.
It is 891 km long and lies on the Brahmaputra.
It is 1,014 km long and lies on the Godavari-Krishna system.
It is 205 km long and lies on the West Coast Canal.
accepted.x: NW-1 is 1,620 km long and follows the Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly system.
accepted.tq: Use the length–river pairing to discriminate among similar National Waterways.
accepted.sec: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Jal Marg Vikas, supported by the World Bank, is associated with the development of which stretch?
accepted.x: Jal Marg Vikas is the World Bank-supported development project for the Varanasi-Haldia stretch of NW-1.
accepted.tq: Link the project name with its specific waterway stretch and funding association.
accepted.sec: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: National Waterway-2 is formed by which river and connects which places?
accepted.x: NW-2 is the Dhubri-Sadiya waterway on the Brahmaputra River.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure river–waterway pair before checking the endpoints.
accepted.sec: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The length of National Waterway-3 is approximately:
accepted.x: NW-3, located on the West Coast Canal, has a length of approximately 205 km.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the short coastal canal waterway from the longer river-based waterways.
accepted.sec: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
accepted.x: NW-3 is associated with the West Coast Canal. NW-1 is on the Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly, NW-2 on the Brahmaputra and NW-5 with the Brahmani-Mahanadi system.
accepted.tq: Find the correctly matched river or canal while rejecting swapped waterway associations.
accepted.sec: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
With reference to National Waterway-4, consider the following statements:
1. It extends from Kakinada to Puducherry.
2. It includes parts of the Godavari and Krishna river systems.
3. It includes the Kakinada, Eluru, Commamur and Buckingham canals.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly describe NW-4, which runs from Kakinada to Puducherry through the stated rivers and canals.
accepted.tq: Check whether all geographic components belong to the same integrated waterway.
accepted.sec: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: National Waterway-5 is associated with which of the following combinations?
accepted.x: NW-5 extends from Talcher/Angul to Paradeep/Dhamra and is associated with the Brahmani-Mahanadi system in Odisha.
accepted.tq: Use both endpoints and the river system to identify the correct waterway.
accepted.sec: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which National Waterway is scheduled to be the starting point of the programme for 20 new National Waterways proposed over five years in the Union Budget 2026-27?
accepted.x: The five-year programme for 20 new National Waterways is proposed to begin with NW-5.
accepted.tq: Identify the first item in a policy sequence rather than the total number alone.
accepted.sec: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The Coastal Cargo Promotion Scheme seeks to increase the inland and coastal cargo share from 6 per cent to what level by 2047?
accepted.x: The scheme aims to raise the inland and coastal cargo share from 6 per cent to 12 per cent by 2047.
accepted.tq: Read the target as a percentage-change question and distinguish the stated target from larger distractors.
accepted.sec: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the change in inland water transport cargo mentioned for the period 2013-14 to 2024-25?
accepted.x: Inland water transport cargo increased from 18 million metric tonnes in 2013-14 to 146 million metric tonnes in 2024-25.
accepted.tq: Check both the direction and the units of the numerical trend.
accepted.sec: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The Jalvahak scheme is associated with which set of National Waterways?
accepted.x: The Jalvahak scheme, introduced in 2024, is associated with NW-1, NW-2 and NW-16.
accepted.tq: Discriminate the exact membership of a scheme’s waterway group.
accepted.sec: National Waterways - number, NW-1 to NW-5, IWAI  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: As of May 2026, what proportion of the Broad Gauge railway network had been electrified?
accepted.x: Broad Gauge electrification had reached 99.6 per cent as of 23 May 2026; it had not yet reached 100 per cent.
accepted.tq: Reject the rounded extreme and select the precise reported percentage.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The NHAI hybrid annuity model corridors cleared around Varanasi are intended to link which National Highways?
accepted.x: The cleared NHAI hybrid annuity model corridors around Varanasi link NH-19 and NH-31.
accepted.tq: Match the project location with the two specified highway numbers.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding transport infrastructure in Andhra Pradesh:
1. The longest stretch of the Golden Quadrilateral lies in Andhra Pradesh.
2. This stretch is approximately 1,014 km long.
3. The proposed East Coast Dedicated Freight Corridor ends at Vijayawada.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: Andhra Pradesh has the 1,014 km longest GQ stretch, and the proposed East Coast DFC ends at Vijayawada.
accepted.tq: Combine a state-specific geographic fact with a transport-corridor endpoint.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which one of the following is identified as the newest railway zone?
accepted.x: South Coast Railway is identified as the newest railway zone.
accepted.tq: Use the superlative ‘newest’ carefully rather than selecting an older neighbouring zone.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The Dedicated Freight Corridor network was reported to be fully operational with approximately how many trains running per day?
accepted.x: The fully operational DFC network was reported to handle 443 trains a day.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise operational figure among close numerical alternatives.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Dedicated Freight Corridors:
1. The East-Coast and North-South DFC reports were under review.
2. Dankuni-Surat DFC was proposed in the Union Budget 2026-27.
3. The DFC network was reported to be fully operational with 443 trains a day.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The East-Coast and North-South reports were under review, Dankuni-Surat was proposed, and the operational network handled 443 trains per day.
accepted.tq: Check each statement against a separate aspect: review status, proposed corridor and operating capacity.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT included among the high-speed rail corridors named in the Union Budget 2026-27?
accepted.x: The named corridors included Hyderabad-Bengaluru, Hyderabad-Chennai and Delhi-Varanasi. Delhi-Kolkata was not among the listed corridors.
accepted.tq: Find the excluded corridor by comparing every option with the named list.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs of cities was NOT among the high-speed rail corridors specifically named in the Union Budget 2026-27?
accepted.x: Mumbai-Pune, Pune-Hyderabad and Chennai-Bengaluru were named corridors. Bengaluru-Mysuru was not included in the listed corridors.
accepted.tq: Use list-based elimination and beware of substituting a plausible but unlisted route.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly states the sequence of airline-sector developments cited in relation to failures?
o: Kingfisher in 2012, Jet in 2019 and Go First in 2023
Jet in 2012, Kingfisher in 2019 and Go First in 2023
Kingfisher in 2012, Go First in 2019 and Jet in 2023
Go First in 2012, Kingfisher in 2019 and Jet in 2023
accepted.x: The cited sequence is Kingfisher's failure in 2012, Jet's in 2019 and Go First's in 2023.
accepted.tq: Arrange the named events by their years and reject swapped dates.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The dominance of IndiGo in India's aviation sector was noted as leaving many Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities served by:
accepted.x: IndiGo dominance was associated with many Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities having only one or two airlines.
accepted.tq: Apply the stated market-structure relationship to the city-category scenario.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
